title: Haddock kedgeree with peas
summary: A fresh-haddock kedgeree: turmeric rice, peas and chopped egg, with the fish poached in the same spiced pan rather than smoked.

ingredients.prepNote: skinned and cut into large pieces

steps.instruction: Cover the eggs with water, bring them to a simmer and boil for 8 minutes. Cool them under the cold tap, peel and chop.
Warm the oil and soften the onion for 5 minutes. Stir in the curry powder and turmeric for a minute until fragrant.
Add the rice and 220 g of the water with half the salt. Cover and cook on a low heat for 12 minutes, until the water is absorbed.
Scatter the peas and lay the haddock on top. Sprinkle with the remaining water, cover, and cook until the fish flakes and the peas are hot.
Fold the fish into the rice, then add the egg, parsley and lemon juice. Taste for salt and serve straight away.

image.alt: Kedgeree of spiced rice, fish and chopped egg
